jobs.detail: LEVER NARROW-GRIP SEATED ROW. Rear-three-quarter view shows back, hands and handle movement. Seated on an unpadded-back rowing station, feet flat on footrests, knees slightly bent, spine neutral and torso slightly inclined forward at hips and unchanged between phases. Hands grasp two CLOSE vertical handgrips with NEUTRAL grip palms facing each other; thumbs wrap securely. Machine is a rigid fixed-pivot rowing LEVER, NOT free weights, with weight stack and cable driving lever. LEFT arms extended in front with soft elbows and shoulders controlled, handles forward. RIGHT pull same handles toward lower ribs/torso, elbows travel BACK close to sides with forearms aligned with neutral wrists, shoulder blades retract. No shrug, spine arch, body swing or changed leg/torso position. Same FIXED machine pivot, same-length steel lever and connected handle geometry, only lever angle changes and stack lifts. PRIMARY mid/UPPER BACK is a very soft blurred RED tint on intact BLACK shirt between shoulder blades; arms/shoulders/lats otherwise grayscale. Entire row apparatus/handles and hands within panels.

Broad natural cloth wrinkles and fully opaque fabric remain across back, sides, front and shoulders. poses.caption: Sit supported with one handle at shoulder height and working elbow bent
Press the same handle overhead while the other hand stays on the thigh

jobs.detail: LEVER ONE ARM SHOULDER PRESS, same RIGHT working arm in BOTH phases. FRONT three-quarter view, working RIGHT arm appears on IMAGE LEFT. Seated upright pelvis/back supported against backrest, both feet flat shoulder-width, ribs down, no back arch or leg drive. Machine has independent pressing lever with fixed upper/rear pivot, visible connected steel arm, horizontal cylindrical overhand handle and weight-stack resistance. RIGHT hand grasps ONE handle overhand with thumb wrapped; LEFT nonworking hand rests on left thigh in BOTH panels, left shoulder relaxed. LEFT PANEL working right elbow bent90degrees at shoulder height, forearm vertical, wrist neutral and handle above elbow. RIGHT PANEL press SAME right handle overhead until right arm almost straight with soft elbow, right wrist above shoulder and upper arm near ear. Opposite left arm stays resting throughout. Same fixed frame/pivot and length lever rotates upward without detaching/lengthening. Only working RIGHT DELTOID (IMAGE LEFT shoulder cap) exposed RED; opposite shoulder, triceps, chest and all other anatomy grayscale. Entire overhead handle and fixed machine fit within panels.
